basic_info.description: Cosmetic Fixer with Expansion Potential in Silver Terrace!!    Opportunity awaits in this classic Silver Terrace home! The main level features 2-bedrooms, 1-bathroom and a convenient overall layout. The living room is bright and adorned with a charming ornate fireplace. Down the hallway is a generous kitchen and dining area where the large windows add all the light from southern exposure. New vision could transform this large footprint and create an enviable space that functions as the heartbeat of this lovely home.    The lower level provides additional room with incredible expansion potential ideal for a home office and guest suite, or comfy family hang out. The backyard is spacious and ready to be reimagined into a private getaway for entertaining, gardening, or relaxing.     Close to freeways, shopping, and transit,   555 Thornton is the perfect canvas for buyers looking to customize and create value for future upside.
